result.instructions: Tools for pretix, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my upcoming events."; "How many tickets remain for my event?"; "Show paid orders for my event.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes pretix data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run pretix_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pretix_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pretix_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. pretix_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pretix_list_organizers
tools.title: List organizers
tools.description: List the organizer accounts this API token can access (slug, name, public URL). A team token sees its own organizer. GET /organizers/.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pretix_get_organizer
tools.title: Get organizer
tools.description: One organizer account: slug, name, public URL. GET /organizers/{organizer}/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

tools.name: pretix_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the events of an organizer (name, slug, dates, live/test mode, currency, location, whether it is an event series). Filter by search text, live state or date. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

live.description: Only events whose ticket shop is live (true) or not live (false).

testmode.description: Only events in test mode (true) or not (false).

has_subevents.description: Only event series (true) or single events (false).

is_future.description: Only events that are current or in the future (event series are never returned).

is_past.description: Only events that are over (event series are never returned).

date_from_after.description: Events starting after this date-time (ISO 8601 with timezone).

date_from_before.description: Events starting before this date-time (ISO 8601 with timezone).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pretix_get_event
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: One event in full: name, dates, location, currency, live/test mode, presale window, meta data, enabled plugins. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

tools.name: pretix_list_subevents
tools.title: List event series dates
tools.description: List the dates (sub-events) of an event series, for one event or across all series of the organizer. Each has id, name, dates, location, presale window and price overrides. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/subevents/ or /organizers/{organizer}/subevents/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

event.description: Event slug. Omit to search across all events of the organizer.

active.description: Only dates whose shop is active (true) or not (false).

is_future.description: Only dates that are current or in the future.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pretix_get_subevent
tools.title: Get event series date
tools.description: One date (sub-event) of an event series. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/subevents/{id}/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

tools.name: pretix_list_items
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the products (ticket types, merchandise) of an event with id, name, default price, tax, active flag, category and variations. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/items/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pretix_get_item
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product with its variations, add-ons and bundles. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/items/{id}/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

tools.name: pretix_list_quotas
tools.title: List quotas
tools.description: List the quotas (capacity pools) of an event: size, the products they cover, closed state and, with with_availability, how many are still available. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/quotas/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

subevent.description: Only quotas of this event series date (sub-event id).

with_availability.description: Add availability fields (available, available_number). Can be slow on big events.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pretix_get_quota_availability
tools.title: Get quota availability
tools.description: How much of a quota is left: available, available_number, total_size and what is using it (pending and paid orders, cart positions, blocking vouchers, waiting list). Values can lag slightly. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/quotas/{id}/availability/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

tools.name: pretix_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders of one event, or of all events of the organizer when no event is given: code, status, email, total, dates, positions, payments, invoice address. Contains customer personal data. Order secrets, order links and payment details are removed. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/orders/ or /organizers/{organizer}/orders/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

event.description: Event slug. Omit to search across all events of the organizer.

status.description: Order status: n = pending, p = paid, e = expired, c = canceled.

search.description: Search text over order code, names, emails and company names.

item.description: Only orders containing this product (item id).

subevent.description: Only orders for this event series date (sub-event id).

testmode.description: Only test-mode orders (true) or live orders (false).

require_approval.description: Only orders waiting for approval (true) or not (false).

created_since.description: Orders created at or after this date-time.

modified_since.description: Orders modified at or after this date-time.

include_canceled_positions.description: Also return canceled positions inside orders.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pretix_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by its code (e.g. ABC12): status, customer email and phone, total, positions (tickets), fees, payments, refunds as recorded, invoice address, check-in flags. Contains customer personal data. Secrets, order link and payment details are removed. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/orders/{code}/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

tools.name: pretix_list_order_positions
tools.title: List tickets (order positions)
tools.description: List the individual tickets (order positions) of one event, or of all events of the organizer when no event is given: attendee name and email, product, variation, price, order code, check-ins, answers. Contains attendee personal data. Ticket secrets are removed. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/orderpositions/ or /organizers/{organizer}/orderpositions/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

event.description: Event slug. Omit to search across all events of the organizer.

order.description: Only tickets of this order code.

search.description: Search text over attendee name, email and order code.

order__status.description: Order status: n = pending, p = paid, e = expired, c = canceled.

has_checkin.description: Only tickets that were checked in (true) or never (false).

subevent.description: Only this event series date (sub-event id).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pretix_list_checkin_lists
tools.title: List check-in lists
tools.description: List the check-in lists of an event (id, name, the products they admit, event series date, rule settings). Use the list id for check-in status, attendee lists and check-in. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/checkinlists/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

subevent.description: Only lists of this event series date.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pretix_get_checkin_list_status
tools.title: Get check-in status
tools.description: Live check-in numbers of a check-in list: how many tickets exist, how many are checked in, how many are inside now, broken down per product and variation. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/checkinlists/{id}/status/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

tools.name: pretix_list_checkin_list_positions
tools.title: List attendees of a check-in list
tools.description: The attendee list of a check-in list: tickets with attendee name, product, order code, check-in history and whether the ticket needs attention. Contains attendee personal data. Ticket secrets are removed; check in by position id. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/checkinlists/{id}/positions/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

search.description: Search text over attendee name, email and order code.

order__status.description: Order status: n = pending, p = paid, e = expired, c = canceled.

has_checkin.description: Only tickets that were checked in (true) or not yet (false).

ignore_status.description: Also list tickets of orders that are not paid or are canceled.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

annotations.title: List attendees of a check-in list

tools.name: pretix_list_waiting_list
tools.title: List waiting list
tools.description: List the waiting list entries of an event: who waits for which product, since when, and whether a voucher was already sent. Contains personal data (name, email, phone). Read-only: no voucher is sent. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/waitinglistentries/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

has_voucher.description: Only entries that already got a voucher (true) or are still waiting (false).

subevent.description: Only this event series date (sub-event id).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pretix_checkin_position
tools.title: Check in a ticket
tools.description: WRITE: check one ticket in (or out) on a check-in list. Records a real check-in in pretix and cannot be undone from here. Identify the ticket by position_id (from pretix_list_checkin_list_positions) or by ticket_secret (the scanned QR code content). pretix applies its own rules: the call is refused for unpaid, canceled, blocked, already-used or wrong-product tickets (the reason is returned), and it never forces a check-in. A required question that is unanswered comes back as incomplete with the question list; answer it with `answers`. One ticket per call. POST /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/checkinlists/{list}/positions/{id}/redeem/.

organizer.description: Organizer slug (see pretix_list_organizers). Optional when the login token sees exactly one organizer.

position_id.description: Ticket (order position) id from pretix_list_checkin_list_positions. Give this or ticket_secret.

ticket_secret.description: The scanned ticket code (secret). Give this or position_id.

answers.description: Answers to required questions: { "<question id>": "<answer>" }. For choice questions use comma-separated option ids.

nonce.description: Idempotency key: a retry with the same nonce does not check in twice. Generated when omitted.
